_comment: AUTHORITATIVE tier contract — the one place the frontend and backend agree.
AIBOS runs as two repos that cannot be deployed atomically, and each used to
keep its own copy of what a plan unlocks. Nothing checked them against each
other, so they drifted silently and shipped real bugs: 'multi_business' was
granted by entitlements.py but missing from tiers.ts (paying Growth owners
locked out of the switcher they'd bought), and the Free chat taster existed
only server-side while the pricing page advertised it (unreachable for a whole
This file is the contract both sides are checked against:
aibos-api  test_tier_contract.py   — asserts entitlements.py + main.py match.
aibos      scripts/check_tier_contract.py — fetches THIS file from main and
Changing what a plan unlocks = edit the code, edit this file, push aibos-api
FIRST, then aibos. Pushing the frontend first just means its check is red
until the backend lands — that redness is the feature working.
